== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Imperial Trooper Guard (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Imperial Trooper Guard]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/imperial_trooper_guard_japanese_white_border/50648 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/0aae31afa6794e819d10d78432bce9e9/IMG_20220607_0119.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(6, 6, 768, 1066)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>63216af2c27c355e31c4ea39f324afe5abbd71bc0006632fef697caea8115819</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
